notes.title: Update v1.30
notes.content: -Added a notification that appears when a checkpoint is unlocked, to make things clearer

notes.title: Update v1.30
notes.content: -Added two teleport checkpoint to the second part of the game. Now deaths are now less punishing and progression feels smoother.

notes.title: Update v1.20
notes.content:
-Anomaly 58 storage room ceiling fixed missing collision
-Anomaly 22 added extra object
-Clients used to see the Mark Tool as white, but now it displays with the correct material as intended
-Removed marking sound from other players
-The anomaly count displayed on the lobby screen has been made clearer and more understandable
-Some graphic bugs fixed

notes.title: Small Update 1
notes.content:
-Removed the Morse puzzle because it was not functioning properly when encountered a second time in the same game. Additionally, the light effect was sometimes triggering multiple times incorrectly.

-Added a "Restart Game" option to allow players to restart the game without needing to exit and relaunch.

notes.title: Exit Together is now available!
notes.content:
Exit Together is now available!

The game is finally released — you can play solo or with a friend.
Check it out on Steam and let me know what you think!

We’d love to hear your thoughts — enjoy the game!

notes.title: Exit Together launches May 29th at 5 PM UTC!
notes.content:
Exit Together launches May 29th at 5 PM UTC!

Team up and solve puzzles with a friend or solo in Exit Together — a co-op escape adventure full of mystery and challenge.

The game goes live on Steam on May 29th at 5:00 PM UTC.
🎮 Add it to your wishlist now and don't miss the launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333740/Exit_Together/

notes.title: We're Almost There!
notes.content:
[b]We're Almost There!

Hey everyone!

Just wanted to give you a quick update — the game is in its final testing phase, and things are looking great so far. If everything stays on track, we’re planning to release it within the next week! [/b]

[i]Also, good news! At launch, the game will support a bunch of languages including English, Turkish, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil), Romanian, Russian, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Swedish, Thai, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Greek, Vietnamese, and Indonesian.[/i]

[b]Thanks so much for all your support — we’re super excited to get the game into your hands very soon![/b]
